text: 'Fix warranty claims' isn't a requirement yet -- it's an intention. This lesson turns it into one precise, testable rule.
Every claim must be a real Salesforce record, visible to the owning rep and their regional manager -- and nobody outside that region.
That matters because Claim_Amount__c holds real customer financial data West and East have no business seeing on each other's claims.
Every claim must also route automatically to the right region, and be reportable by status and age for Marisol Fontaine's team.
Next: scoping V1 honestly -- what this build actually ships, and what gets deferred.
